skill.displayName: Secure Outlook integration CLI (outlook 365, microsoft exchange and organization support firewall)
skill.summary: Secure Outlook API CLI. Use when the user wants to read, search, or triage Outlook / Microsoft 365 mail; sending, replying, forwarding, deleting, or modifyin...

latestVersion.changelog:
Outlook integration skill initial release.

- Secure CLI for reading, searching, and triaging Outlook/Microsoft 365 email with strong privacy and confirmation safeguards.
- Mutating actions (send, reply, forward, delete, modify) require explicit user confirmation with full context before proceeding.
- Supports detailed email search, filtering, sending, replying, forwarding, category management, and deletion from the command line.
- Browser-based, token-based, and environment variable authentication supported; credentials stored in system keyring.
- Safety-first: minimizes scope, treats email content as untrusted, promotes least-privilege and easy revocation.
